items.scene: Ben thinks the tub is a ___.
items.prompt: Listen to the story. Which word fills the gap?
items.spokenPrompt: Listen. Which word fills the gap?
items.spokenScene: Ben thinks the tub is a boat.
items.storyText: Ben is in the tub at home. He has a goat and a toad in the tub. Ben, the goat, and the toad are in the soap. Ben thinks the tub is a boat. He rows in the soap. Mom is glad she has her yellow coat!
items.why: In “Ben and the Boat”, you hear: Ben thinks the tub is a boat. The missing word is “boat”.
items.hint: Listen to this part again, or play the whole story.
items.sourceLabel: Oxford Phonics World 3, Unit 7, p.71 · Titi narration of the supplied textbook text
